newsitem.title: UK: Argos shares fall on cautious outlook.
newsitem.headline: Argos shares fall on cautious outlook.

text.p: Shares in catalogue retailer Argos Plc were indicated lower on Monday after the company warned that low growth and higher costs in the first half of 1997 would make it difficult to improve on last year's earnings.
The shares were down 6-1/2p at 632-1/2p by 0828 GMT.
The stores group announced a 13.7 percent rise in annual pretax profits to 141.4 million stg in 1996, just above analysts estimates.
Argos said sales growth in the first 10 weeks of 1997 was up 14 percent and seven percent on a like-for-like basis. Gross margins were in line with the same period a year ago.
"The profits were in line but the statement was cautious," said one dealer.
